t: This is the Prudential World War II Memorial, a war memorial in London. It was made by Ferdinand Victor Blundstone, who lived from 1882 to 1951. Blundstone was a Swiss-born sculptor who worked in England. His father, Charles, was an India rubber merchant born in Manchester. Blundstone studied at the South London Technical Art School and then at the Royal Academy Schools. As you look at the memorial, you're seeing the work of a trained sculptor who made his career in England.
